description: This PHP class 'RulesetStandardLibrary' provides internal functions for AWS endpoint evaluation, including regex patterns for IP addresses, URL parsing, ARN parsing, host validation, and function resolution within AWS SDK's endpoint ruleset.

classes.name: RulesetStandardLibrary
